briefdescription.para: The "resume-switch" lowering, where there are separate resume and destroy functions that are shared between all suspend points.

detaileddescription.para: The coroutine frame implicitly stores the resume and destroy functions, the current index, and any promise value.

briefdescription.para: The "returned-continuation" lowering, where each suspend point creates a single continuation function that is used for both resuming and destroying.
The "unique returned-continuation" lowering, where each suspend point creates a single continuation function that is used for both resuming and destroying.

detaileddescription.para: Does not support promises. The function is known to suspend at most once during its execution, and the return value of the continuation is void.

briefdescription.para: The "async continuation" lowering, where each suspend point creates a single continuation function.

detaileddescription.para: The continuation function is available as an intrinsic.
